title: GEMglEdgeFlag
description: flag edges as either boundary or nonboundary

messages.description: current edge flag, 1 (GL_TRUE, the default) or 0 (GL_FALSE)

arguments.description: current edge flag, 1 (GL_TRUE, the default) or 0 (GL_FALSE)

body: [GEMglEdgeFlag] calls glEdgeFlag() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glEdgeFlag in the OpenGL reference.
